It mostly records hearsay, so basically everything in it is nonsense except for several familiar names.
Someone jotted down what he had seen about the world. Most were gossips that faintly revealed the extreme of people's imaginations of heroes' personal lives.
That being said, there were some sincere words that made you wish it would be great if those had been more than hearsay.
On the last page, the owner named Elvin said he didn't want to write anymore, but he hoped that the beautiful, false hearsay could be passed on forever.

Oh, I never expected that there would be so many different accounts about the story of that natural daughter.
— Klein.
Hmm? Why mention my name?
— Klein.

It's a conversion device installed on Selene. Though it resembles the device of modern technology in terms of function, slight differences remain.
The great achievement reveals the deicide complex in humanity. To control the future of everyone, the numerous talented minds honed the sharp sword that challenges all rules.
Before the final moment came, how would the driver passionate about grand shows look like when he found out the feebleness of Selene? No one could tell.

Some of the structures aren't essential. Did they adopt this design just in order to get a higher budget?
— Klein.

The soils have been penetrated by Honkai energy for years, making them a unique source of energy if a suitable conversion structure is put in place.
Tens of thousands of years ago, the moon base was built thanks to the recycling of such energy.
The ones who know the truth will try to utilize it through the power left by Samsara, so that Samsara itself can be cut off. This is so arrogant!
Perhaps humans will one day perish as a result of such arrogance. But before that happens, they will continue to survive and reach their zenith.

Fine, at least it can be my back-up energy.
— Klein.

Though the appearance has been repaired as much as possible, the reeds have been lost and the harmonica can't be played anymore.
In the cosmic space where sound can't be heard, this musical instrument is meaningless. When the girl was about to die, she sent it as a gift to the boy and it accompanied him to the very end. Only one who experienced all these could understand what it means.
But nobody knows if the boy had ever tried to play this instrument again when he had sealed his own fate as a hero.
Nevertheless, he chose to keep the keepsake before he died. Just like they agreed when parting, the boy would play a beautiful song when they met again in a better place.

What you left hasn't fully disappeared.
— Klein

It used to be one of the 10th Divine Keys. The core has been gone after being damaged, and it can't be used as a weapon even after the maximum repair.
Indeed, its old owner was boisterous and capricious, and his physical strength was so great that most weapons couldn't match him. But this weapon had been intact before it perished alongside its owner in the Showdown.
Either way, the man stuck to his promise and fought with his past friends to the last moment and wielded sword towards the gods.

The inscriptions belong to the Previous Era, and they mean Emile.

—

It's a device developed by an anonymous genius. Thought it has a wide range of usages, its personal trait is too outstanding to be applied elsewhere.
She always chose to have leeway for everything she took on, and never has she been cornered. But she didn't do so in the case of her own life.
She once said that the greatest spirit of humanity is the spirity to fight against Creator.
In the end, she lived up to her theory. The con-artist offered her true self to face up to the countdown before the end, though she could have offered a lie.

Sorry, I can't have a strucutral analysis. She... is an existence beyond everyone else.
— Klein.
